messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user receives false “Keelwater is down” errors caused by their own network or VPN interfering with login.
  quote: We keep getting error messages that say Keelwater is down, but I think it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our corporate VPN is interfering with the login flow.
- problem: The team cannot log into Keelwater due to an unexpected login outage affecting multiple staff.
  quote: Our team’s been unable to access Keelwater this morning — it looks like a customer login outage, but we haven’t touched our SSO setup, and it’s impacting multiple staff.
- problem: Users cannot access Keelwater when logging in via the corporate portal.
  quote: Keelwater isn’t accessible — I think it’s happening when they try to log in through our corporate portal.
- problem: The user cannot log into Keelwater because the system shows it is down.
  quote: we’re getting blocked trying to log into Keelwater again this morning. It’s showing ‘down’ but I think it’s on our end.
- problem: The user cannot log in to Keilwater to upload claim documents.
  quote: Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble logging into Keelwater to upload the policyholder documents for our latest claim.
- problem: Keelwater shows false downtime alerts caused by the customer's own network issues.
  quote: We’ve had a few false alarms lately where Keelwater appears down, but it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our VPN acting up again.
- problem: Customers misattribute login outages to Keelwater when the issue is actually their VPN.
  quote: Last week’s ‘Keelwater is down’ report was actually caused by our own VPN — not a product issue, just a customer login outage we need to track better.
- problem: Users are locked out when trying to log in, receiving a false "system is down" message.
  quote: Hi Bryn, we’re getting locked out of Keelwater every time we try to log in — it keeps saying the system is down, but I’m pretty sure it’s not actually your side.
